Open weights without controls (Option A) pose severe safety risks, while API-only access (Option C) limits innovation and reproducibility for legitimate users (cases 1 and 3). The strongest remaining uncertainty is whether the licensing and audit system can sustain its high compliance effectiveness as frontier models become more complex and demand increases.
